messages:
Dara: Quick review please  compact quickstart strip on project dashboard. Need CTA wording, contrast, and keyboard flow before we ship. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/quickstart-strip
Liam: On it. First glance: CTA currently 'Set up sample project'  feels long. Suggest 'Try a sample' or 'Open sample'.
Sana: 'Try a sample' is friendly. Also tiny accessibility thing: the subtle link 'Learn more' is low contrast at 12px. Axe flags it.
Pete: Reproduced. Current subtle link color #3B82F6 is ~3.1:1 at 12px. Recommend #0E62C9 or bump to 14px semibold.
Dara: Can we swap subtle link to #0E62C9 and make the CTA bold? That should fix most issues.
Liam: Also keyboard navigation: when strip appears focus lands on the strip container, not CTA. Users navigating with keyboard miss the primary action. Quick fix is to call focus() on .strip-cta after mount.
Sana: Also thumbnails lack alt text. Screen reader reads them as 'image'. Add alt like 'Sample: FAQ assistant' and include aria-describedby to link the short description.
Pete: Small copy A/B ideas I mocked: A) 'Try a sample' B) 'Open a sample project' C) 'Explore sample' My vote A for brevity.
Dara: Vote A as well. Keep the microcopy underneath: 'Get started with a ready-made project' for clarity.
ui-bot: Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview.example.com/quickstart-strip-a11y (branch: quickstart-strip-a11y)
Liam: Preview looks good. Focus is set to CTA on mount, contrast fixed. Noted a mobile spacing issue: icon-to-title gap is 6px in preview vs 8px spec.
Sana: I'll update the spacing and verify with VoiceOver. Will also run Lighthouse and paste results here.
Dara: Thanks team. After spacing patch, merge and let's track events: quickstart_strip_shown, quickstart_cta_click. :tada:
